name: Mirror Mirror
source:
You meet a lone elf who has known you for longer than you think. You're stuck, you realize, and he's your only way out.

...but will you be able to leave?


Mirror Mirror is an upcoming yandere visual novel about an elf named Aster who accidentally transports you to his realm, learn more about him and find your way back home before it's too late.

[From [url=https://numsanity.itch.io/mirror-mirror]itch.io[/url]]
